summary: Feed s101_single is degraded due to excessive encryption: 86.6% of bytes are encrypted vs 60% IDS tolerance, blinding payload inspection. All other checks (duplicates, missing VLAN, one-way traffic, packet drops, tool overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Traffic is dominated by TLS/encrypted flows (86.6% encrypted bytes) with no upstream decryption. IDS receives ciphertext instead of cleartext payload, likely because feed is tapped before or without an SSL visibility/decryption zone.
findings.impact_on_tool: This IDS requires full payload for signature and anomaly detection and tolerates ~60% encrypted. At 86.6% encrypted, most sessions are opaque, so IDS cannot match payload signatures and will miss intrusions, malware and C2 over TLS.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypting relevant TLS centrally (packet broker SSL decryption or dedicated decryption appliance) and forwarding a cleartext copy to the IDS restores payload visibility while keeping the encrypted share below the 60% tolerance, without affecting other healthy checks.
